verdict.rationale: Chroma is an API-driven database with no GUI dependency. The docs say it can run locally or self-hosted, the official CLI can start a local server, a Python client is shown, and a published OpenAPI spec exists, so scripted, headless use is clearly supported. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or Docker-in-CI recipes, non-interactive CLI auth), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
